input.summary: Limit HDI's convenience termination to the end of the then-current term and cap the Termination Payment at three months' fees.
input.comment: [Playbook] Our position is that HDI should not be able to walk away mid-term and that any exit fee is capped: we have limited HDI's 90-day termination to the end of the then-current term and capped the Termination Payment at three months of Section 3 fees. The Company's existing 90 days' notice right is unchanged.

ops.text: Any termination by HDI under this Section 4.1 shall be effective only at the end of the then-current term, and any Termination Date specified in HDI's notice shall be the last day of that term.
In no event shall the Termination Payment exceed the fees payable to HDI under Section 3 for the three (3) months preceding the Termination Date.
